column2: My name is Maria. And you?
What do you have in your bag?

column1: Έχω ένα βιβλίο και ένα στυλό. Εσύ;
column2: I have a book and a pen. You?

column1: Έχω ένα κινητό, ένα κλειδί και νερό.
column2: I have a phone, a key, and water.
No. Do you have a pen?
Yes, I do. Here you go!
Would you like a little water?
Yes, I'd like a little…, thank you.
Yes, I'd like a little water, thank you.
Yes, I'd like tea, thank you.
I also have a sweet. Would you like one?
A little? Do you want a little?
Nikos, do you want tea too?

column1: Ο Νίκος θέλει καφέ, αλλά δεν έχω καφέ! Έχω τσάι.
column2: Nikos wants coffee, but I don't have coffee! I have tea.

column2: Maria has a sweet. Nikos wants coffee, but…
I want to, but I can't.

column1: Γεια σου, Νίκο! Μπορώ; (points to the empty chair)
Θέλω καφέ. Μπορείς σήμερα το βράδυ;
column2: I want a coffee. Can you make it tonight?

column1: Λυπάμαι, δεν μπορώ. Θέλω, αλλά δεν μπορώ.
column2: Sorry, I can't. I want to, but I can't.

column1: Η Μαρία δεν μπορεί το πρωί. Μπορεί το βράδυ.
column2: Maria can't in the morning. She can in the evening.

column1: Καλά. Αύριο το πρωί εμείς, και το βράδυ η Μαρία!
column2: Okay. Tomorrow morning us, and in the evening Maria!

column1: Βλέπω τη θάλασσα. Βλέπω και μια βάρκα.
column2: I see the sea. I also see a boat.

column1: Ναι, βλέπω τον ήλιο. Και ένα βουνό.
column2: Yes, I see the sun. And a mountain.

column1: Ναι, βλέπω μια εκκλησία και ένα σπίτι.
column2: Yes, I see a church and a house.
Good morning! What would you like?

column1: Καλημέρα! Ένα νερό και έναν καφέ, παρακαλώ.
column2: Good morning! A water and a coffee, please.
I can't see… / I don't see…

column1: Ωχ! Πού είναι το κινητό μου;
Δεν ξέρω. Δεν βλέπω το κινητό σου.
column2: I don't know. I don't see your phone.

column1: Δεν έχω το κινητό μου! Και τα κλειδιά μου;
column2: I don't have my phone! And my keys?

column1: Όχι, δεν είναι… Μισό λεπτό… Εδώ είναι!
column2: No, it isn't… Wait a second… Here it is!
Great! Can you come now? I want a coffee.
No, I can't. I'm busy with work.

column1: Δεν θέλω αυτό. Θέλω το βιβλίο. Ορίστε δύο ευρώ.
column2: I don't want this one. I want the book. Here are two euros.
Thank you! Have a good day!
Do you know? – I don't know.
Good. Do you want to get a coffee?

column1: Θέλω, αλλά δεν έχω ώρα σήμερα.
column2: I'd like to, but I don't have time today.

column1: Αύριο το πρωί μπορώ. Ξέρεις το καφενείο;
column2: Tomorrow morning I can. Do you know the kafeneio?
And Maria? Does she want to come?

column1: Η Μαρία θέλει, αλλά δεν μπορεί. Έχει δουλειά.
column2: Maria wants to, but she can't. She has work.

column1: Ένα καφέ και ένα τσάι, παρακαλώ.
column2: A coffee and a tea, please.
Do you see Maria? She's here!
Now I can! I want a coffee!
Nice to meet you. I'm Nikos.

column1: Είμαι από την Ελλάδα, από την Κρήτη.

column2: Are you here with your family?
Yes, I have a family here.

column1: Τι ωραία! Θέλεις να δεις την Αμερική;
column2: How nice! Do you want to see America?
I want to, but I can't right now.

column1: Είναι από την Ελλάδα, από την Κρήτη.

column2: How many pieces do you have?

column1: Ωραία! Αυτή είναι η μητέρα σου;
Ναι, και αυτός είναι ο πατέρας μου.
column2: Yes, and this is my father.
Do you have a brother or a sister?

column1: Έχω έναν αδελφό και μια αδελφή.
column2: I have a brother and a sister.

column1: Ναι, έχουν τρία παιδιά. Εσείς; Έχετε παιδιά;
column2: Yes, they have three kids. And you? Do you have kids?

column1: Ναι, έχουμε δύο παιδιά. Θέλουν γλυκά!
column2: Yes, we have two kids. They want sweets!

column1: Η γιαγιά μου και ο παππούς μου είναι στην Ελλάδα.
column2: My grandmother and grandfather are in Greece.

column1: Όχι, δεν μπορούμε. Αλλά έχουμε φωτογραφίες!
column2: No, we can't. But we have photos!

column1: Θέλω να κάνω…, αλλά δεν μπορώ.
column2: I want to do…, but I can't.
What do you do in the morning?

column1: Το πρωί πίνω καφέ. Μετά δουλεύω.
column2: In the morning I drink coffee. Then I work.

column1: Ναι, δουλεύω στο σπίτι. Εσύ; Τι κάνεις το πρωί;
column2: Yes, I work from home. You? What do you do in the morning?
In the morning I'm at work.
At midday I take a break.

column1: Το βράδυ θέλω να κάνω γυμναστική, αλλά δεν μπορώ. Είμαι κουρασμένη!
column2: In the evening I want to exercise, but I can't. I'm tired!

column1: Κι εγώ! Το βράδυ θέλω να διαβάσω, αλλά βλέπω τηλεόραση.
column2: Me too! In the evening I want to read, but I watch TV.

column1: Χα! Μπορούμε να κάνουμε γυμναστική μαζί;

column2: Yes! I can in the morning.
I want to go to the sea.
We're going to church. / Let's go to church.

column1: Πάω στο σούπερ μάρκετ. Μετά πάω στο σπίτι.
column2: I'm going to the supermarket. Then I'm going home.
Where are you going on Saturday?
I want to go to the beach!

column1: Την Κυριακή πάμε στην εκκλησία, και μετά στο χωριό.
column2: On Sunday we go to church, and then to the village.

column1: Τι ωραία! Θέλω να πάω στο χωριό σου!
column2: How nice! I want to go to your village!
We can go in the summer.
Good morning! How much are the tomatoes?
I'd like a kilo of tomatoes, please.

column1: Ναι, έχω. Καλαμάτας. Πέντε ευρώ το κιλό.
column2: Yes, I do. Kalamata. Five euros a kilo.

column1: Θέλετε και πατάτες; Είναι πολύ καλές.
column2: Do you want potatoes too? They're very good.
No, thank you. How much is everything?

column1: Δύο και δυόμισι… τέσσερα και πενήντα.
column2: Two plus two and a half… four fifty.

column1: Και πενήντα λεπτά ρέστα. Καλή σας μέρα!
column2: And fifty cents change. Have a good day!
Come this way. What will you drink?
I'd like a glass of wine.

column1: Θα ήθελα ψάρι και μια σαλάτα.
column2: I'd like the fish and a salad.

column2: I don't eat fish. I'd like meat, a souvlaki.

column1: Ναι! Το ψάρι είναι πολύ νόστιμο.

column2: Can you on Tuesday at six?

column2: Oh, okay. Can you do Tuesday at six? I want to go for coffee.

column1: Την Τρίτη δεν μπορώ. Την Τετάρτη μπορώ.
column2: I can't on Tuesday. I can on Wednesday.

Είναι νωρίς για μένα. Στις εφτά;
column2: That's early for me. At seven?
Excuse me, do you speak English?
A little. Do you speak Greek?
Good for you! Where are you from?

column2: From America. I want to learn Greek.
How lovely! How long have you been learning?
How… long… have you been learning?

column2: Can you say that again? I want to hear it again!

column2: Fournos. Thank you! Do you know where the bakery is?
On Sunday I go to church.
I want to learn to cook.
Good! Can you get together today?

column2: Today I can't, I have work. Tomorrow at ten?

Yes! I want tomatoes and olives.

column2: I don't know… I don't see your phone.
Here it is! In my bag.

column2: Oh no, it's late. I want to go home.
What will you do this weekend?

column2: On Saturday I'll go to the beach with my friends.

column2: On Saturday I'll work. But on Sunday I'll have time.

column2: Yes, I'll watch a movie with the kids. And then we'll go for a walk.

column2: Do you want to come to the beach on Sunday?

column2: I can't, but next Saturday I'll come!

column1: Θα είναι πολύ ωραία. Καλό Σαββατοκύριακο!
column2: That will be really nice. Have a good weekend!

column2: Have a good Lent! What's the weather like today?

column2: It's a little cold, but it's sunny.

column2: Yes, it's very windy! It's a good day for a kite.

column2: Yes, I have a big kite. Let's go to the hill!

I have lagana, olives, and halva.

column1: Βλέπω τον χαρταετό σου! Είναι πολύ ψηλά!
column2: I see your kite! It's really high!

column2: Never mind. Let's go home. It's cold now.

column2: Can you tell me where … is?

column2: Excuse me, can you tell me where the square is?

column2: Excuse me, I don't see the square. Is it here?

column2: No, the square is behind the church.

Yes! Today is the 25th of March.

column2: Happy holiday! Do you see the flags? The parade is over there.
Yes, I see them! Thank you so much!

column2: I live in a small house near the sea.

column2: How nice! Is it new or old?

column2: It's white with a blue door.

column2: It has two small rooms and a big kitchen.

column2: A big kitchen! Do you eat in the kitchen?

column2: Yes! The kitchen is red. You? Do you have a house or an apartment?

column2: I have a new apartment. It's small, but it has a big balcony.

column2: Can you see the sea from the balcony?

What do you like to do?

column2: I like to run. I go to the gym every day.

column1: Κάθε μέρα; Μπράβο! Σου αρέσει η μουσική;
column2: Every day? Good for you! Do you like music?

column2: Yes, I really like Greek music.

column2: I like Greek songs, but I don't understand the lyrics.

column1: Κι εγώ! Σου αρέσουν οι ταινίες;
column2: Me neither! Do you like movies?

column1: Όχι πολύ. Μου αρέσει να διαβάζω.
column2: Not much. I like to read.

column2: I love moussaka! I want to eat right now!

column2: Yesterday I wanted to go, but I couldn't.

Last year I was in Greece.

column2: Hi! I wanted to see you yesterday.

column2: I couldn't yesterday. I had a lot of work.

column2: In the evening I was at home. I was very tired.
Yes, I was watching a movie. You?

column2: I wanted to go to the beach, but I couldn't. I didn't have a car.

column2: Yes, last year I had one, but now I don't.

column2: Do you want to go together on Saturday? I have a car.

On Saturday I went to the beach.

column2: With Maria. I saw Nikos there too!

column2: He said "Hi!" and then he ate an ice cream.

column1: Έφαγα ψάρι και ήπια μια μπίρα. Εσύ τι έκανες;
column2: I ate fish and had a beer. What did you do?

column1: Είχα πολλή δουλειά. Την Κυριακή πήγα στην εκκλησία και μετά ήπια έναν καφέ με τη γιαγιά μου.
column2: I had a lot of work. On Sunday I went to church and then had a coffee with my grandmother.

column2: Good! She said she wants to see you.
Do you want a red egg?

column2: Have a blessed Resurrection! Do you have a candle for the Resurrection service?

column2: Yes, I have a white candle. The kids have colorful ones.

column2: Yes, on Holy Thursday we dye red eggs. Do you want a red egg?

column2: I have tsoureki from Grandma. It's delicious.

column2: I'll be here, at church. You?
Christ is risen! – Truly He is risen!
Truly He is risen! What can I get you?

column1: Με πονάει το κεφάλι. Έχετε κάτι για το κεφάλι;
column2: I have a headache. Do you have something for it?

column2: Yes, of course. Does your throat hurt too?

column1: Όχι, ο λαιμός μου είναι καλά. Αλλά δεν μπορώ να κοιμηθώ.
column2: No, my throat is fine. But I can't sleep.

column1: Ορίστε. Ένα χάπι τρεις φορές την ημέρα. Αν δεν είστε καλύτερα, πηγαίνετε στον γιατρό.
column2: Here you go. One pill three times a day. If you don't feel better, go to the doctor.
Thank you. How much is it?

column1: Έναν καφέ και ένα νερό, παρακαλώ.
column2: A coffee and a water, please.

column1: Θα πάω στη θάλασσα. Θέλεις να έρθεις;
column2: I'll go to the beach. Do you want to come?
